headline: Amazon reportedly building database of online products
summary: Amazon is reportedly building a database indexing products sold anywhere online, including items it does not sell itself, according to Reuters. The project has been described as the 'World Product Graph.'

claims.statement: Amazon is building a product database covering items sold online, including products it does not sell itself.

sources.quote: Amazon has a plan to index the world’s online shopping data
Amazon is reportedly working on a database for 'virtually every item for sale on Earth'

claims.statement: The database is reported to include products Amazon does not sell.

sources.quote: This would include products that the online commerce giant doesn't even sell.
